name: Bless
summary: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

name: Cure Wounds
summary: A creature you touch regains 2d8 + spellcasting modifier HP (2024: 2d8 base).

name: Guiding Bolt
summary: Ranged spell attack, 4d6 radiant; next attack against the target has advantage.

name: Healing Word
summary: A creature regains 2d4 + spellcasting modifier HP at range.

name: Shield
summary: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.

name: Sleep
summary: 2024: creatures in a 5-ft-radius sphere make a Wisdom save or gain Incapacitated, then Unconscious at end of their next turn if still in range.

name: Thunderwave
summary: 2d8 thunder, Constitution save for half; failed targets are pushed 10 ft.

name: Hold Person
summary: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Paralyzed; repeats the save at the end of each turn.

name: Misty Step
summary: Teleport up to 30 ft. to a space you can see.

name: Spiritual Weapon
summary: Floating weapon; bonus action melee spell attack for 1d8 + modifier force.

name: Web
summary: 20-ft cube of webs; Dexterity save or Restrained. Flammable.

name: Counterspell
summary: 2024: the caster makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC or the spell fails.

name: Dispel Magic
summary: Ends spells of level 3 or lower on a target; higher-level spells need an ability check (DC 10 + spell level).

name: Fireball
summary: 20-ft-radius sphere, 8d6 fire, Dexterity save for half.
